post.description:
Issues a short-lived one-time ticket used to establish a realtime WebSocket connection.
Call this endpoint with the same Bearer JWT used for regular HTTP endpoints, then
pass the returned ticket to `/ws?ticket={ticket}&role={consumer|provider}`.

401.description: Authentication failed or the authenticated user id could not be obtained from the request context.

500.description: The ticket could not be issued.

get.description:
Establishes a WebSocket connection for realtime event delivery.
The client must first request a ticket with `POST /ws-tickets`, then open
`/ws?ticket={ticket}&role={consumer|provider}`. The ticket is one-time use.

Once connected, the client receives push events for activity relevant to
the authenticated user and selected role.

**Conversation message event:**
```json
{
  "type": "conversation.message.created",
  "conversation_id": 123,
  "message": {
    "id": 456,
    "sender_role": "consumer",
    "content": "Hola, necesito un presupuesto",
    "created_on": "2026-06-04T12:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

**Notification created event:**
```json
{
  "type": "notification.created",
  "notification": {
    "id": 15,
    "user_id": 1,
    "type": "service_proposal_received",
    "resource_type": "service_proposal",
    "resource_id": 10,
    "read_at": null,
    "created_at": "2026-07-04T13:00:00Z"
  }
}
```

BearerAuth.description: Auth0-issued JWT. The API uses the token subject claim as the internal auth identifier.

RegisterConsumerRequest.description: Payload accepted by POST /consumers. The implementation trims surrounding whitespace from all string fields before validation/persistence. The profile photo is optional.

email.description: Consumer email. Must match the server email validation regex.

name.description: Consumer given name or display name. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

surname.description: Consumer surname. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

profile_photo_file_id.description: Optional confirmed public profile photo file identifier uploaded by the authenticated consumer.

ConsumerSummary.description: Consumer account created by the registration operation.

profile_photo_url.description: Public profile photo URL. Omitted when the consumer registered without a photo.

RegisterProviderRequest.description: Payload accepted by POST /providers. The implementation trims surrounding whitespace from email, name, and surname before validation/persistence. category_id and profile_photo_file_id are required by the domain service. coverage_zone is currently accepted by the request struct but ignored by the service.

name.description: Provider given name. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

surname.description: Provider surname. The current implementation persists the value but does not enforce non-empty validation.

coverage_zone.description: Accepted by JSON binding for backwards compatibility, but the current handler does not pass this value to the provider service and it is not persisted.

profile_photo_file_id.description: Confirmed provider profile photo file identifier returned by the file upload flow.
